description: Java class HonoCommander for managing device commands and responses in a JMeter testing context, including connection handling, message processing, and command execution.

classes.name: HonoCommander
classes.description: Main class for managing device command interactions, including connection setup, message handling, and command execution.

methods.name: HonoCommander
methods.description: Constructor initializing the commander with sampler configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Establishes connection and message consumers, returns a CompletableFuture indicating success or failure.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Performs a sampling operation, sending commands and collecting results based on trigger type.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes connections and cleans up resources, returning a CompletableFuture.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Hono, returns a Future with the connection.

methods.name: createMessageConsumers
methods.description: Creates message consumers for event and telemetry data.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, logs message content.

methods.name: handleCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Handles device readiness notifications, triggers command sending.

methods.name: sendCommandAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a command to a device and processes the response, updating success/error counts.

methods.name: setCommandTimeOut
methods.description: Sets timeout for command client requests.

methods.name: setSampleStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Records start and end times for sampling.

methods.name: setSampleStartIfNotSetYet
methods.description: Sets the sample start time if not already set.
